# megapot-starter-kit — file manifest for AI agents

A Vite + React 19 + wagmi v2 reference frontend for the Megapot on-chain
lottery (USDC on Base). Forkable; white-label-ready. Source of truth for
the integration patterns documented at https://llms.megapot.io.

## Entry points

- README.md — fork-in-5-minutes, env vars, customize index, deploy
- AGENTS.md — JSDoc convention guide for navigating the kit
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — API/RPC division, polling cadence, decisions
- docs/CUSTOMIZE.md — every rebrand seam in one checklist
- docs/DISCLAIMER.md — Infrastructure Participant interface notice
- .env.example — environment variables with rationale for each
- LICENSE — MIT

## Source

### src/pages/ — one component per top-level tab
- src/pages/Home.tsx — live drawing state, countdown, prize-tier projection
- src/pages/Play.tsx — ticket purchase orchestration (jackpot / bulk / subscribe)
- src/pages/Tickets.tsx — wallet stats, current draw, unclaimed wins, past rounds
- src/pages/LP.tsx — deposit + withdraw against the LP manager (gated by LP_ENABLED in src/config/contracts.ts; default off)
- src/pages/History.tsx — paginated round list (Data API backed)

### src/hooks/ — TanStack Query wrappers
#### RPC reads
- src/hooks/useJackpotState.ts — hybrid lifecycle reader (poll + 4 event subs)
- src/hooks/usePrizeTiers.ts — pre-settlement tier projections
- src/hooks/useUsdcBalance.ts — ERC-20 balanceOf
- src/hooks/useUsdcAllowance.ts — ERC-20 allowance (driver for ApprovalButton)
- src/hooks/useLpInfo.ts — LP pool state, cap, drawing-state

#### RPC writes
- src/hooks/useBuyTickets.ts — Jackpot.buyTickets (≤10 tickets path)
- src/hooks/useBulkPurchase.ts — BatchPurchaseFacilitator + BatchOrderExecuted polling
- src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts — JackpotAutoSubscription create / cancel / status
- src/hooks/useClaimWinnings.ts — Jackpot.claimWinnings batched per round
- src/hooks/useClaimReferralFees.ts — operator's accumulated fees
- src/hooks/useLpDeposit.ts — USDC approve + lpDeposit
- src/hooks/useLpWithdraw.ts — initiateWithdraw → finalizeWithdraw two-step

#### Data API reads (api.megapot.io)
- src/hooks/useActiveRound.ts — live-round aggregate (tickets, players, lp_earnings) on a 30s refetch
- src/hooks/useRound.ts — single-round detail (settled rounds are immutable)
- src/hooks/useRoundsList.ts — paginated rounds list, invalidates on JackpotSettled
- src/hooks/useUserTickets.ts — wallet tickets for one round (current OR past)
- src/hooks/useWalletStats.ts — lifetime aggregate (tickets, wins, spend, referral)
- src/hooks/useWalletTickets.ts — wallet ticket history (cross-round)
- src/hooks/useWalletWins.ts — wallet wins with claimed filter

### src/components/ — UI primitives + composite sections
- src/components/common/ — primitives reused across pages
  - Button.tsx — primary/secondary/danger variants (white-label seam)
  - ApprovalButton.tsx — generic USDC approve (any spender, exact-allowance)
  - CopyButton.tsx — click-to-copy + 1s flash
  - DataApiCredit.tsx — "via Megapot Data API" link (rebrand seam)
  - UsdcAmount.tsx — 6-decimal raw bigint → human readable
  - TxStatus.tsx — pending / confirmed / failed pill
- src/components/layout/ — app shell
  - Layout.tsx — Nav + Footer container
  - Nav.tsx — top tabs (desktop) + bottom tab bar (mobile)
  - ProfileCard.tsx — connect button + balance pill + referral fee claim (md+ only)
  - MobileWalletBar.tsx — sub-md header sub-row: connect CTA or address + ETH/USDC + Disconnect
  - Footer.tsx — disclaimer link + chain badge
  - BrandMark.tsx — logo SVG seam
  - DisclaimerLink.tsx — disclaimer link seam
- src/components/icons/ — inline SVG icons (one file per icon)
  - HomeIcon.tsx, PlayIcon.tsx, TicketsIcon.tsx, LpIcon.tsx, HistoryIcon.tsx
  - CopyIcon.tsx, CheckIcon.tsx, ExternalLinkIcon.tsx
- src/components/lottery/ — current-drawing surfaces
  - PrizePool.tsx, Countdown.tsx, PrizeTiers.tsx, LifecycleStatus.tsx
  - TicketBuilder.tsx — number entry + qty slider + custom-pin
  - SubscriptionToggle.tsx — one-time vs subscription mode toggle
  - BulkProgress.tsx — bulk-buy chunked progress
- src/components/tickets/ — wallet + history surfaces
  - WalletStatsCard.tsx — lifetime stats (Data API)
  - CurrentDrawingTickets.tsx — RPC-backed ticket list
  - TicketCard.tsx — numbers + match status
  - ActiveSubscription.tsx — subscription status + cancel
  - UnclaimedWins.tsx — wins to claim, per-row claim inlined
  - PastRoundTickets.tsx — round-detail ticket listing
  - ClaimReferralFees.tsx — operator earnings claim
- src/components/lp/ — LP page surfaces
  - PoolStatus.tsx — Open/Closed badge + capacity hint
  - DepositForm.tsx — USDC approve + lpDeposit form
  - WithdrawTwoStep.tsx — initiate → finalize flow with locked-drawing banner
- src/components/history/ — history page surfaces
  - DrawingList.tsx — paginated rounds with expanded-row detail

### src/config/ — chain-aware addresses + brand config + diagnostics
- src/config/contracts.ts — chain-aware addresses + REFERRER_ADDRESS (env-driven via VITE_REFERRER_ADDRESS) + TICKET_SOURCE
- src/config/wagmi.ts — wagmi + RainbowKit config; reads VITE_APP_NAME
- src/config/copy.ts — single source for user-facing English strings
- src/config/diagnostics.ts — boot-time placeholder warnings (dev-only) + bigint polyfill

### src/lib/ — shared utilities
- src/lib/api.ts — Data API client + types + QK query-key constants + retry helper
- src/lib/tickets.ts — randomization, route picker, cost calc, MAX_CLAIM_BATCH

### src/ — root
- src/main.tsx — providers (Wagmi / QueryClient / RainbowKit) + bigint polyfill imports
- src/App.tsx — tab state + Layout shell
- src/index.css — Tailwind directives

### server/ — optional backend proxy
- server/proxy.ts — framework-agnostic Hono proxy for the Data API

### examples/ — platform deploy references (NOT active by default)
- examples/deploy-vercel-function.ts — Vercel Functions wrapper for server/proxy.ts
- examples/deploy-cloudflare-worker.ts — Cloudflare Workers wrapper
- examples/README.md — index + deploy walkthrough

## Config

- package.json — pnpm scripts (dev, build, typecheck, lint, format, setup)
- vite.config.ts — Vite + React plugin
- tailwind.config.ts — brand.primary token scale + content globs
- biome.json — Biome 2.x lint + format config
- tsconfig*.json — TypeScript project references (app + node tooling)
- index.html — root with rebrand markers + theme-color
